original.statement: The cilium-agent flag --k8s-watcher-endpoint-selector has had no effect since v1.14, is now deprecated, and will be removed in v1.18.

decision.reason: [ev-b7f3339817fc] lists this under "Deprecated Options". It names the `--k8s-watcher-endpoint-selector` flag and the cilium-agent component, says the flag "has been deprecated" and says it "will be remove[d] in v1.18". That supports a cli-flag subject spelled exactly as proposed, with component cilium-agent. The change type "deprecated" is also supported: the flag stopped having any effect in v1.14, so the only new thing in 1.17 is the deprecation.
